title: Algorithmic Monoculture in Machine Learning-based Site-Specific Fertilizer Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36941v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Machine learning recommendations are often evaluated one model at a time, despite deployment across interconnected decision makers. For continuous NPK fertilizer prescriptions, correlated errors can aggregate across farms and generate systemic costs. A model of shared and farm-specific recommendation errors links expected social loss to model adoption shares; the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index characterizes concentration effects when common model errors are independent and predictive risks are equal. A covariance-generalized formulation captures the dependence between model families. A two-model threshold characterizes when privately optimal monoculture is socially dominated, and a convex portfolio rule limits average private predictive regret. translated_title: 基于机器学习的精准施肥推荐中的算法单一化
translated_abstract: 机器学习推荐系统通常被一次只评估一个模型，尽管它们被部署在众多相互关联的决策者之间。对于连续的氮磷钾（NPK）施肥处方，模型间的相关误差可能在农场之间累积并产生系统性成本。本文构建了一个包含共享误差与农场特定推荐误差的模型，将预期社会损失与模型采用份额联系起来；当共同模型误差相互独立且预测风险相等时，赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数刻画了集中度效应。一个基于协方差的广义化公式捕捉了模型族之间的依赖关系。一个双模型阈值刻画了私人最优的单一化策略何时在社会层面被多样化策略所超越，而一个凸组合规则限制了平均私人预测遗憾。来自摩洛哥五个谷物系统的九个模型族提供了基于基准的校准。在说明性参数和10%的遗憾上限下，受准确性约束的模型多样化降低了建模的社会损失。
tldr: 本文提出了一个将模型采用集中度与社会损失相联系的理论框架，揭示了精准施肥推荐中的“算法单一化”会导致农场间预测误差系统性累积并产生社会成本，而准确性约束下的模型组合多样化可以有效降低这种损失。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework linking model adoption concentration to social loss, showing that algorithmic monoculture in site-specific fertilizer recommendations causes correlated errors to aggregate systematically across farms, while accuracy-constrained model diversification reduces overall social costs.
